source_note: 无理测度的定义以及基本的命题
callout_id: 无理测度的定义以及基本的命题#11
statement_en: If $\alpha$ is an algebraic number of degree $d$ ($d\geq 2$), then there exists a constant $C(\alpha)>0$ such that $$\left|\alpha-\frac{p}{q}\right|>\frac{C(\alpha)}{q^d}$$ for every positive integer $q$ and every integer $p$.
key_techniques: lower bounds for rational approximation to algebraic numbers
callout_body: 如果$\alpha$是一个d次代数数($d\geq 2$)，那么存在一个常数$C(\alpha)>0$使得不等式$$\left|\alpha-\frac{p}{q}\right|>\frac{C(\alpha)}{q^d}$$对任意正整数$q$以及任意整数$p$成立。
